messages:
incident-bot: Pager: 3xx alert - multiple nodes in `infer-usw` pool transitioned to NotReady within 2m. Affected: inference pods evicted -> increased 5xxs on hosted API. :pager:

alex: i'm on it, paging oncall now. any customer-facing impact?

support: seeing a spike in 502/504 from hosted API routes for customers on us-west2. Spike started ~2m ago. ticket #INC-4321 created.

maria: logs show kubelet restart loops on nodes infer-usw-03/04/08. kubelet uptime <30s then restart. CPU around 80%, but dmesg has OOM killer on container runtimes. also seeing GPU driver resets.

sam: can you paste the node describe and kubelet logs?

maria: paste below:

```
$ kubectl describe node infer-usw-03
Name:               infer-usw-03
Conditions:
  Type             Status  LastHeartbeatTime
  Ready            False   2026-03-15T10:04:12Z (kubelet restarted)
Allocated resources:
  (total limits may be over 100%)
Events:
  10m   Warning  KubeletRestarted  kubelet restarted unexpectedly
  9m    Warning  NodeNotReady      kubelet is not posting status
```

and dmesg snippet:
```
[  123.456789] Out of memory: Kill process 9876 (nginx) score 123 or sacrifice child
[  123.457001] gpu 0000:3b:00.0: GPU reset: GPU locked, resetting
[  123.457210] nvidia: GPU instance 0 reset triggered
```

jess: ugh GPU resets + oom, looks like a runaway pod is eating mem on host causing kubelet to panic and restart. any recent deploys?

alex: deploy-bot shows no recent model-serving deploy in last 30m. last autoscaler change 45m ago.

infra-bot: Node health check: infer-usw pool has 6 nodes, 3 currently NotReady. autoscaler has 2 spare nodes in Pending. Quota available.

sam: mitigation plan: 1) cordon+drain obviously bad nodes, 2) scale up spare nodes immediately (prefer non-preemptible), 3) temporary routing to standby pool eu-west2 for heavy customers, 4) kill suspected runaway pod on each host if present, 5) monitor 5xxs and latency.

maria: running cordon now on infer-usw-03/04/08.

```
$ kubectl cordon infer-usw-03 && kubectl drain infer-usw-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
node/infer-usw-03 cordoned
node/infer-usw-03 evicted 8 pods
```

jess: i'm checking kubelet logs for PID patterns. suspect model-worker process id ~22xx repeatedly spawning.

sam: scale action: bump infer-usw node pool +3, preferring type gput2-large, avoid preemptible.

```
$ cloud-cli scaling resize --pool infer-usw --add 3 --node-type gput2-large --no-preemptible
Scaling started -> expected 3 new nodes
```

alex: also adding temporary routing rule to send 30% of inference traffic to infer-eu-west standby for high-throughput customers.

support: posting status update to customers: "We're investigating increased errors in US-West inference. Traffic is partially routed to EU as mitigation; short-term latency may increase for some customers." :loudspeaker:

maria: found crashlooping container on infer-usw-04: model-worker pid 2219 repeatedly OOMing with large segfault allocation. dumping container logs -> shows large batch compile spikes.

```
[model-worker] allocating 22GB workspace for compilation
[model-worker] cuda: cuCtxCreate failed: CUDA_ERROR_UNKNOWN
[model-worker] oom_kill: kgdb invoked
```

jess: kill the runaway container, set restartPolicy=Never on that pod to avoid re-creating until we adjust jobs.

```
$ kubectl delete pod model-worker-2219 -n inference --grace-period=0 --force
pod "model-worker-2219" deleted
$ kubectl patch pod model-worker-2219 -n inference -p '{"spec":{"restartPolicy":"Never"}}' || true
```

sam: confirm nodes are draining and new nodes coming up. watching autoscaler.

infra-bot: New nodes provisioned: infer-usw-new-11/12/13 are booting. Kubelet ready once nvidia-driver install completes.

alex: while new nodes join, we should relax bin-packing on gpu pods: change topologySpreadConstraints and reduce per-pod mem request temporarily to reduce OOM pressure. propose a rolling patch to model-serving helm chart.

maria: agreed. opening quick patch to reduce workspace default from 22GB -> 12GB and enable compile-caching.

```
# helm values patch (quick rollbackable):
modelWorker:
  workspaceGB: 12
  enableCompileCache: true
```

jess: patch applied, kube rollout in progress. monitor for regressions.

support: customer impact update: errors decreased by 70% after drain/scale + routing. several VIP customers still seeing elevated latency, we're sending personalized notes.

sam: important: why did kubelet restart? likely OOM on host due to unbounded compile allocations causing driver resets -> kernel oom -> kubelet crashloop. need followups: enforce node-level cgroups for model-worker processes, add mem-limits on pods, add a pre-start check to prevent massive compile on hosts with low memory.

alex: creating incident ticket and postmortem stub: /inc create "infer-usw kubelet crashloop due to model compile OOM + GPU resets" -> assigned to eng-runtime + infra.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-4321. Priority: P1. Owners: eng-runtime (sam, jess), infra (maria). Runbook link: <link to runbook>.

maria: current state: all NotReady nodes cordoned, 3 new nodes joined and Ready, model-worker pods rescheduled. kubelet restarts ceased on nodes that got patched. still seeing 1 node with intermittent driver reinit in logs but stable.

alex: summary for post-incident: 1) root cause: model-worker compile memory usage + no hard cgroup limit -> host OOM -> kernel killed processes and GPU driver reset -> kubelet crashloop. 2) mitigations: temporary routing + scale up + cordon/drain, quick helm patch to lower workspace, kill runaway pods. 3) action items: enforce node-level cgroups, set pod mem limits, install guard to avoid heavy compile during low host memory, add alert for GPU driver resets, update runbook.

sam: i'll take action items for runtime changes, jess + maria for infra and driver monitoring, alex will coordinate customer comms and postmortem writeup.

support: leaving customer notes with ETA for full postmortem.

alex: closing pager, will update once postmortem draft ready. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Pager closed by alex at 2026-03-15T10:22:00Z.

jess: prepping postmortem draft in docs/incidents/INC-4321-draft.md - linking when ready."
